user_query: What conditional probability does LINE define for generating a context vertex vj from a vertex vi, and over what set is this distribution defined?
llm_response: LINE defines the conditional probability of generating a context vertex v_j from a vertex v_i as p(v_j \mid v_i) = \frac{\exp(\mathbf{u}_j^\top \mathbf{v}_i)}{\sum_{k=1}^{|V|} \exp(\mathbf{u}_k^\top \mathbf{v}_i)}. This distribution is defined over all vertices in the graph, i.e., the full vertex set V.
llm_confidence_reasoning: This is the standard softmax conditional probability used in LINE, and the denominator sums over the entire vertex set.
